description: Estimate an inland waterway barge freight rate for a bulk commodity, origin, destination, distance, and weight, from USDA's weekly downbound grain barge rates. Only priced when both ends are Mississippi/Illinois/Ohio River ports, the lane runs downriver, and the shipment is at least one barge-load (~1,500 short tons, 3,000,000 lb); otherwise returns available: false with the reason. Priced on river miles. Returns a directional benchmark for planning. Each call counts as one estimate toward the account's monthly FreightFA allowance.

commodity_type.description: Commodity being shipped, e.g. 'grain', 'corn', 'coal'. Barge only carries bulk commodities.

destination.description: Destination city and state, e.g. 'New Orleans, LA'.

distance.description: Lane distance in miles. recommend_mode returns it for a city or ZIP pair.

origin.description: Origin city and state, e.g. 'Minneapolis, MN'.

name: estimate_barge_rate
title: Estimate barge rate
